system.description: Essence surges through the Dragon-Blood's touch and purges the body of contamination. With a touch, the Dragon-Blood can expel any mundane poison or disease from a patient's system immediately, ending its effects without further progression. Against supernatural toxins, this Charm allows a Medicine roll (difficulty equal to the poison's Toxicity) to remove it. Success purges the toxin entirely; failure means the toxin continues to progress normally. Against disease, the Charm automatically removes mundane illnesses and makes a Medicine roll at the same difficulty for magical or supernatural diseases. This Charm may only be used on a given patient once per scene per condition.
